display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.adminAuthority} changes Marinade's authorities and operating accounts
${accounts.managerAuthority} adds validator ${accounts.validatorVote} to Marinade with score ${data.score}
${accounts.managerAuthority} removes validator ${data.validatorVote} from Marinade
${accounts.managerAuthority} sets the score of validator ${data.validatorVote} to ${data.score}
${accounts.managerAuthority} sets the extra stake delta runs to ${data.extraRuns}
${accounts.transferFrom} stakes ${data.lamports} with Marinade for mSOL, sent to ${accounts.mintTo}
${accounts.stakeAuthority} hands stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount} to Marinade for mSOL, sent to ${accounts.mintTo}
${accounts.getMsolFromAuthority} unstakes ${data.msolAmount} at once through Marinade's liquidity pool, less the pool's fee, with the SOL sent to ${accounts.transferSolTo}
${accounts.transferFrom} adds ${data.lamports} to Marinade's mSOL-SOL liquidity pool, with the LP tokens sent to ${accounts.mintTo}
${accounts.burnFromAuthority} burns ${data.tokens} to withdraw from Marinade's mSOL-SOL liquidity pool, with SOL sent to ${accounts.transferSolTo} and mSOL to ${accounts.transferMsolTo}
${accounts.adminAuthority} changes the settings of Marinade's liquidity pool
${accounts.adminAuthority} changes Marinade's settings
${accounts.burnMsolAuthority} orders a delayed unstake of ${data.msolAmount}, recorded in ticket ${accounts.newTicketAccount}
The SOL of delayed-unstake ticket ${accounts.ticketAccount} is claimed and sent to ${accounts.transferSolTo}, its beneficiary
${accounts.rentPayer} stakes SOL from Marinade's reserve with validator ${accounts.validatorVote}, in new stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount}
Marinade updates its record of active stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount}
Marinade withdraws deactivated stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount} to its reserve
${accounts.splitStakeRentPayer} deactivates Marinade stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount}, or a part of it split into ${accounts.splitStakeAccount}
${accounts.validatorManagerAuthority} deactivates stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount} in an emergency
${accounts.validatorManagerAuthority} asks to unstake ${data.desiredUnstakeAmount} from stake account ${accounts.stakeAccount}
Marinade merges stake account ${accounts.sourceStake} into ${accounts.destinationStake}
Marinade creates canonical stake account ${accounts.canonicalStake} by splitting stake account ${accounts.sourceStake}
${accounts.pauseAuthority} pauses Marinade
${accounts.pauseAuthority} resumes Marinade

${accounts.burnMsolAuthority} burns ${data.msolAmount} for new stake account ${accounts.splitStakeAccount}, split from Marinade's ${accounts.stakeAccount}, with ${data.beneficiary} as its staker and withdrawer
${accounts.adminAuthority} resizes Marinade's validator list for ${data.capacity} validators, with rent paid by ${accounts.rentFunds}
${accounts.adminAuthority} resizes Marinade's stake list for ${data.capacity} stake accounts, with rent paid by ${accounts.rentFunds}
Marinade carries on its delinquent-validator upgrade over up to ${data.maxValidators} validators

fields.name: treasuryCut
docs: Treasury cut

fields.name: slotsForStakeDelta
docs: set by admin, how much slots before the end of the epoch, stake-delta can start

fields.name: lastStakeDeltaEpoch
docs: Marks the start of stake-delta operations, meaning that if somebody starts a delayed-unstake ticket
after this var is set with epoch_num the ticket will have epoch_created = current_epoch+1
(the user must wait one more epoch, because their unstake-delta will be execute in this epoch)

fields.name: extraStakeDeltaRuns
docs: can be set by validator-manager-auth to allow a second run of stake-delta to stake late stakers in the last minute of the epoch
so we maximize user's rewards

docs: Validator vote pubkey

docs: Validator total balance in lamports

fields.name: totalActiveBalance
docs: sum of all active lamports staked
